            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Check required symbols present initially
    initial_symbols = set(n["symbol"] for n in nodes)
    if not required_symbols.issubset(initial_symbols):
        raise ValueError("Required symbols not present in initial tree")
    
    # Retained set
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    
    # Candidates: removable nodes sorted by depth descending, then id ascending
    candidates = [n for n in nodes if n.get("removable", False)]
    candidates.sort(key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removed_order = []
    
    for candidate in candidates:
        nid = candidate["id"]
        
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        
        # Never remove if has retained children
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove and check coverage
        retained.remove(nid)
        
        retained_symbols = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(retained_symbols):
            removed_order.append(nid)
        else:
            retained.add(nid)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": sorted(retained)
    }

    if "nodes" not in case or "required_symbols" not in case:
        raise ValueError("Missing required fields: nodes or required_symbols")
    
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    node_map = {}
    for n in nodes:
        if "id" not in n or "parent" not in n or "symbol" not in n or "depth" not in n or "removable" not in n:
            raise ValueError(f"Node missing required fields: {n}")
        node_map[n["id"]] = n
    
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            if n["parent"] not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    initial_symbols = set(n["symbol"] for n in nodes)
    if not required_symbols.issubset(initial_symbols):
        raise ValueError("Required symbols not all present in initial tree")
    
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    
    candidates = [n for n in nodes if n["removable"]]
    candidates.sort(key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    removed_order = []
    
    for candidate in candidates:
        nid = candidate["id"]
        
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        retained.remove(nid)
        
        retained_symbols = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)
        
        if required_symbols.issubset(retained_symbols):
            removed_order.append(nid)
        else:
            retained.add(nid)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,

    }
